content: If she hadn't sent me a text today, I wouldn't have written this piece, because I want to forget that stretch of my life, even though it did teach me something. She said she wanted to talk on the phone. I didn't think there was anything worth talking about. She called while I was asleep. When I woke up and saw she had called, I blocked her number so she wouldn't call again.
